remarks:
PRICE IMPROVEMENT! A great opportunity in a great location! This two-story home is now
offered at an improved price, making it the perfect time to take another look. The fabulous
layout and stunning family room are just some of the great features this home offers. Beautiful
hardwood Floors that really showcase the home! Granite countertops, plenty of kitchen
workspace, breakfast and coffee bar areas are sure to create happiness and joy! The open floor
plan where the living and dining areas blend effortlessly are a favorite feature for hosting
guests or relaxing. Covered maintenance free front porch and a covered side patio facing a
fenced yard that creates a perfect retreat. Additional living space is a plus in the finished
basement and workshop areas! Explore the local attractions: Tonawanda Rails to Trails, Two
Mile Creek Greenway Trail, Veteran and Niawanda Parks and quaint Twin-Cities downtown
businesses located near Niagara River and Erie Canal! Just minutes from our beautiful attractions
at Niagara Falls and Buffalo! Start your New Beginnings and Adventures in this Lovely Home!
